digest.component_or_area: Jira DC harness setup and capability mapping
propositions: The Jira DC image is amd64-only and exists only in CI, requiring an on-demand mapping job to interrogate it rather than relying on repeated failed deployments to discover capabilities
Environment contract must be manually dispatched, produce committed artifact with raw request/response evidence, and only re-run when the image is re-pinned — not execute on every test harness run

All four rebar vocabularies (priority, type, status, link relation) must be validated against the live instance with structured present/absent/present-but-different verdicts, not just name-presence checks
Link type direction cannot be verified by name alone; end-to-end tests must write links and read them back from both sides to detect inverted inward/outward mappings
Five hardcoded length limits (summary, label, description, comment, ADF) must be measured empirically at limit-1/limit/limit+1 with accept-and-truncate cases detected by read-back, not assumed

The mapping job's provenance — which digest it actually interrogated — must be derived from the Dockerfile's FROM line and committed as asserted data, not hardcoded as a second literal that could drift
